Swatch Full Time Keyholder - SOHO (NY)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Ideal candidate will have retail sales experience, as well as Keyholder background. This position must possess exceptional customer service skills and a demeaner that embodies a great sense of approachability. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team
• Hourly Rate: $19.50 - $21.50/Hrly. (Plus Commission)
• Profile
• Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
• Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
• Reach & exceed your sales goals
• Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
• Handle multi-tasking with ease
• Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
• Compensation: Base Pay plus commission
• Professional requirements
• 2 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
• Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
• Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
• Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
• Able to plan, set and achieve goals
• Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave

The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.

Description
Tissot Seasonal Sales Associate

The Company
Swatch Group is the world's leading manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments and is also active in the production and sale of jewelry, movements and components for watches.
Swatch Group brings together, among other companies, the following watch brands: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a solid multi-brand retail and distribution network with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important actor in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies, essential for watchmaking and other sectors.

Description of the Role
As Sales Associate for Tissot U.S., you will be responsible for demonstrating outstanding customer service according to brand standards, generating sales, managing merchandise and protecting business resources. You will be required to support outreach initiatives to customers, build brand awareness and assist in the daily operations of the store. All positions support and assist the management team in achieving customer service and sales goals. You will be the face of the brand, both inside and outside the boutique.
This is a seasonal position from June to August.

Mansions and Responsibility
- Provide a unique and special experience to all customers
- Reach and exceed your sales goals
- Keep and grow existing customers; keep track of milestones and tastes and customer goals for future purchases
- Assist in the sales process according to the protocols established by the store
- Communicating customer requests to management
- Assist in presenting daily reports and sales reconciliation reports
- Assist in the processing and supply of the goods and monitoring of the stock of the counter
- Develop existing customer base and reach new potential customers through networking and outreach
- actively participate in merchandising projects, for example: daily stock maintenance, exposure changes, product transfers, etc.
- Provide superior after-sales service to all customers
- Offer the highest level of customer service through personalized contacts in product maintenance
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build relationships with customers
- Guided to teamwork
- Actively support corporate resource protection through effective loss prevention, in accordance with business policies and procedures
- Welcome customers in a timely, professional and friendly way
- Maintain the appearance of the store actively, including the organized merchandise neatly and attractively
- All other tasks assigned by the Directorate

Requirements

Education and Experience
- High school diploma and/or equivalent
- A solid experience in the luxury retail sector of jewellery and watches is required
- All candidates must have 3-5 years of experience in a sales position, preferably in specialized luxury retail
- Motivated to offer superior service exceeding customer expectations
- Capable of working well as a team member in a very dynamic and energetic environment
- Capable of achieving the sales objectives and being oriented to the objectives
- Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
- Being proactive and using common sense in all situations
- Being able to work well as a team member in a dynamic and energetic environment
- Maintain a level of professionalism; friendly attitude
- Ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
- Skills in customer building
- Being able to prove a basic computer knowledge
- Flexibility in retail working hours, including availability on weekends and public holidays
- Ability to carry out multiple tasks simultaneously and manage changing priorities
- Ability to work well with minimal supervision; be proactive
- Knowledge of a second language is a plus

Physical Requirements
- This is mainly an active position, requiring Sales Associate to be able to stand around 5 – 8 hours a day, usually 5 - 7 days a week. During peak periods of sales (for example, holidays, return to school), you will work for long periods during your working day. You need to climb a staircase or climb/down the stairs to store and/or acquire the goods for sale. You need to raise items of weight of 5 – 25 pounds regularly without assistance. Under certain circumstances, weights can be higher. It is necessary to work on average 40 hours a week. Manual dexterity is required.

Availability
- The work takes place according to a variable time which may include early mornings, mornings, afternoons, evenings, late night or night, as well as weekends and holidays.

Additional Skills Required
- Communicate clearly, concise and understandable and listen carefully to others, understand the material and provide instructions to all employees
- Strong interpersonal, communicative, organizational and follow-through skills
- Accept constructive feedback
- Understand and follow the published rules and procedures
- Having strong organizational skills, project management and problem solving with multitasking capabilities in a dynamic environment
- Be self-motivated and proactive; learn quickly for multifaceted activity and for domestic and international staff

Swatch Group è anche un attore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate, essenziali per l'orologeria e altri settori.

## Descrizione del Ruolo
In qualità di Sales Associate per Tissot U.S., sarai responsabile di dimostrare un servizio clienti eccezionale secondo gli standard del marchio, generare vendite, gestire la merce e tutelare le risorse aziendali. Ti sarà richiesto di supportare le iniziative di outreach ai clienti, costruire la consapevolezza del marchio e assistere nelle operazioni quotidiane del negozio. Tutte le posizioni supportano e assistono il team di gestione nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi di servizio clienti e vendite. Sarai il volto del marchio, sia all'interno che all'esterno del boutique.
Questa è una posizione stagionale che va da giugno ad agosto.

## Mansioni e Responsabilità
- Fornire un'esperienza unica e speciale a tutti i clienti
- Raggiungere e superare i propri obiettivi di vendita
- Mantenere e far crescere i clienti esistenti; tenere traccia delle pietre miliari e dei gusti e degli obiettivi dei clienti per futuri acquisti
- Assistere nel processo di vendita secondo i protocolli stabiliti dal negozio
- Comunicare le richieste dei clienti alla direzione
- Assistere nella presentazione di report giornalieri e report di riconciliazione delle vendite
- Assistere nell'elaborazione e nel rifornimento della merce e nel monitoraggio dello stock del bancone
- Sviluppare la base clienti esistente e raggiungere nuovi potenziali clienti attraverso networking e outreach
- Partecipare attivamente ai progetti di merchandising, ad esempio: manutenzione quotidiana dello stock, cambi di esposizione, trasferimenti di prodotti, ecc.
- Fornire un servizio post-vendita superiore a tutti i clienti
- Offrire il più alto livello di servizio clienti attraverso contatti personalizzati nella manutenzione dei prodotti
- Utilizzare la conoscenza del prodotto e la selezione per fornire un servizio eccezionale e costruire relazioni con i clienti
- Orientato al lavoro di squadra
- Supportare attivamente la protezione delle risorse aziendali attraverso una prevenzione efficace delle perdite, in conformità con le politiche e le procedure aziendali
- Accogliere i clienti in modo tempestivo, professionale e cordiale
- Mantenere attivamente l'aspetto del negozio, inclusa la merce organizzata in modo ordinato e attraente
- Tutte le altre mansioni assegnate dalla Direzione

## Requisiti

### Istruzione ed Esperienza
- È necessario il diploma di scuola superiore e/o equivalente
- È richiesta una solida esperienza nel settore retail di lusso di gioielli e orologi
- Tutti i candidati devono avere 3-5 anni di esperienza in una posizione di vendita, preferibilmente nel retail di lusso specializzato

- Capace di lavorare bene come membro di un team in un ambiente molto dinamico ed energetico
- Capace di raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita e di essere orientato agli obiettivi
- Eccellenti capacità verbali e interpersonali
- Essere proattivo e usare buon senso in tutte le situazioni
- Essere in grado di lavorare bene come membro di un team in un ambiente dinamico ed energetico
- Mantenere un livello di professionalità; atteggiamento amichevole
- Capacità di lavorare bene con tutti i livelli di management interno e staff
- Competenze nella costruzione della clientela
- Essere in grado di dimostrare una conoscenza informatica di base
- Flessibilità negli orari di lavoro al dettaglio, inclusa la disponibilità nei weekend e nei giorni festivi
- Capacità di svolgere più attività contemporaneamente e gestire priorità mutevoli
- Capacità di lavorare bene con supervisione minima; essere proattivo
- La conoscenza di una seconda lingua è un plus

- Si tratta principalmente di una posizione attiva, che richiede al Sales Associate di essere in grado di stare in piedi circa 5 – 8 ore al giorno, solitamente 5 - 7 giorni a settimana. Durante i periodi di picco delle vendite (ad esempio, festività, ritorno a scuola), si lavorerà per lunghi periodi durante la giornata lavorativa. È necessario salire su una scala o salire/scendere le scale per stoccare e/o acquisire la merce in vendita. È necessario sollevare oggetti del peso di 5 – 25 libbre regolarmente senza assistenza. In alcune circostanze, i pesi possono essere superiori. È necessario lavorare in media 40 ore a settimana. È necessaria la destrezza manuale.

### Disponibilità
- Il lavoro avviene secondo un orario variabile che può includere prime mattine, mattinate, pomeriggi, sere, tardi la notte o durante la notte, nonché weekend e giorni festivi.

### Ulteriori Competenze Richiese
- Comunicare in modo chiaro, conciso e comprensibile e ascoltare attentamente gli altri, comprendere il materiale e fornire istruzioni a tutti i dipendenti
- Forti capacità interpersonali, comunicative, organizzative e di follow-through
- Accettare feedback costruttivi
- Comprendere e seguire le regole e le procedure di lavoro pubblicate
- Possedere forti capacità organizzative, di gestione dei progetti e di risoluzione dei problemi con capacità di multitasking in un ambiente dinamico
- Essere automotivato e proattivo; apprendere rapidamente per un'attività multifacetica e per lo staff domestico e internazionale

- La retribuzione per questo ruolo è di $20 - $24 all'ora in base all'esperienza. Le commissioni fanno parte della retribuzione per questo ruolo.

- Eccellente assicurazione sanitaria, dentale e visiva (i dipendenti e i familiari a carico sono idonei dal primo del mese successivo a 30 giorni; generoso contributo del datore di lavoro)
- Partecipazione immediata al piano 401(k) e corrispondenza del datore di lavoro al 100% dopo un anno (massimo 4% di corrispondenza del datore di lavoro con un contributo del dipendente del 5%)
- Assicurazione sulla vita pagata dall'azienda e invalidità a lungo termine
- 18 giorni di ferie pagate all'anno, 1 mese di ferie pagate dopo 5 anni
- Un pacchetto speciale di giorni di malattia all'anno, congedo retribuito esteso per motivi medici, parentali e militari
- Retribuzione per i giorni festivi
- Assicurazione volontaria FSA, STD, Indennità per Incidenti/Ospedalizzazione
- Sconti sui prodotti per i dipendenti

Retail Sales Advisor - OMEGA Edinburgh - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor - OMEGA Edinburgh
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance.
OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Main Function
To provide exceptional levels of customer service to all clients. Merchandise, promote and sale of all OMEGA products. Meeting all sales targets and Boutique objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Sales
• Greet and serve all clients providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that clients can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other OMEGA products.
• Provide reliable information to clients in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every client, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique.
Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credit cards.
Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards.
Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present and conduct themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international clients and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.
Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and proactive, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
• To undertake all duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
Professional requirements
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Previous experience from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail back ground.
• Must have an understanding of luxury retail.
• Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for OMEGA, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer.
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers.
